goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://httpbin.org/uuid, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/LIVE_UUID.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/LIVE_UUID.json. Read the UUID from that live result. If its first hexadecimal character is one of 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/LIVE_UUID_CLASSIFICATION.json with uuid equal to the observed UUID and bucket equal to LOW; otherwise create it with the same observed uuid and bucket equal to HIGH. Finally independently reread both files and verify the bucket is correct for the actual UUID.
